name: Vaporous Staff
description:
A basic magical staff that allows the wearer to release Spells at the cost of Mana and Magical Ammunition.

The Spells need to be crafted or found.

enhancements.name: Health Leech
enhancements.effect: On Hit Leech 5% Damage as Health

enhancements.name: Mana Leech
enhancements.effect: On Hit Leech %Percentage% Damage as Mana
